commits.messageBody:
[hermit2, degraded-unresolved, gpt-5.6-sol, devbig014, role=impl]

Back fixed synthetic proc snapshots and supported dynamic fdinfo reads with
owned memfds that are populated before receiving immutable content seals.
Use read-only and O_PATH reopens for fixed snapshots and read-only reopens for
supported fdinfo content, keeping construction descriptors out of the guest
table.

Match the scoped Linux open, proc-fd, metadata, and mutation-error behavior,
including runtime-selected create-directory precedence on older kernels.
Preserve fdinfo lifecycle identity while separating pathname existence from
whether Reverie can render a target's fdinfo content.

Add exact native matrices, unit coverage, and required-KVM coverage for the
sealed-carrier and error-ordering behavior.
commits.messageHeadline: kvm: seal synthetic proc snapshot descriptors

commits.messageBody:
[hermit2, degraded-unresolved, gpt-5.6-sol, devbig014, role=impl]

Correct pre-6.4 create-plus-directory ordering for /proc/mounts and
dynamic fdinfo paths. Keep negative fdinfo leaves at ENOENT, distinguish
the fdinfo directory trailing slash as EISDIR, and clear stale virtual
O_NOFOLLOW state when a descriptor number is reused.

Add native and guest pwrite ordering checks for fdinfo carriers, explicit
seal and credential controls, and disclose the remaining generic-carrier
and statx residuals.

Tested with 33 focused synthetic-proc tests, one required real-KVM test,
815 full reverie-kvm library tests, strict all-target Clippy, native open
matrices, and four failing causal mutations.
commits.messageHeadline: kvm: correct legacy proc flag precedence
